invariant: CLI and process invocation preserve zero, one, many arguments and paths containing spaces
external cancellation is classified separately from build failure and cannot produce COMMITTED
required runtime modules are verified before execution
payload completeness is checked before activation
COMMITTED requires SHA-256 plus post-write readback evidence
a committed recovery step cannot be replayed as pending
JSON readers tolerate UTF-8 BOM while writers emit canonical UTF-8
long operations expose machine-readable liveness and operation identity
retrying a completed operation does not duplicate publication or corrupt state
failed finalization restores the previously validated destination
external CI unavailability cannot corrupt local state or block autonomous local recovery
cancellation terminates the supervised process subtree and leaves recoverable state
COMMITTED for a critical published artifact requires explicit artifact durability flush in addition to SHA-256/readback evidence
durability primitives are qualified on every supported OS; Windows file flush uses a writable descriptor while Linux/Windows regression suites both pass
after atomic publication, supported platforms flush the containing directory entry before COMMITTED can be returned
atomic receipt publication reopens/fsyncs the final receipt and flushes the parent directory where supported before readback

once a matching COMMITTED receipt may have crossed its atomic replace boundary, publication failure is reconciled/read back or reported COMMIT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN; the durable artifact is never blindly rolled back
